event.description: Tie two FF hidden units input/output weights within each block
event.proposal: family: parameter tying; current retained incumbent is 2856 parameters at 100.0000%, a +1.00 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: attempt-0058, tying one FF hidden unit input/output weights within each block at 2856/100.00%; same-family failed result: attempt-0041, sharing the complete FF output projection across blocks at 2864/10.19% (attempt-0040 shared the input projection at 2864/7.83%). Prior attempts in this family: 6. Hypothesis: extend the directly successful localized tie by one additional hidden unit, preserving all 23 hidden activations and all cross-head connectivity while tying two hidden units input/output weights within each block. This removes 28 parameters per block and targets 2828 total. This is more informative than the nearest untested alternative of tying three units because it measures the next incremental redundancy boundary after the accepted one-unit result; it also preserves the same initialization and optimization conditions for a clean local comparison. Keep d14/h2/L2, MQA, independent head-local maps, rank8 positions, affine-free block pre-norms, final learned scale without bias, reversed operands, zero weight decay, mixed-digit curriculum, and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 2856 parameters.
